kind: independent Q1/Q3 re-measurement of the post-replay serve window; one real KU Leuven trial, one short replay, probes after the replay ended

baseline.note: the fix under test is the commit at HEAD: 'auditory_ui: keep serving after the replay ends, instead of dying with it'

media_out: output/auditory_ui/serve_verify_q1.wav (explicit; output/auditory_ui/demo_stereo.wav was never opened by this run)
url: http://127.0.0.1:52781/ (ephemeral port, read back from the demo's own log)
probe_timing: the probe ran 12 s after the log line 'replay finished; still serving ... (for 60s)' appeared; the serve window is 60 s, so every probe is inside the window and after the replay was over

observed.session_stream_status_after_replay: the /api/state snapshot is the same body the browser polls; its newest packets are the attention/gain packets at timestamp 16.0 (the last window) and the transport's session packet with status 'stopped'

head_finding.observation: HEAD /api/media/file -> 404 while a ranged GET on the same path, seconds later in the same window, -> 206
head_finding.mechanism: inferred, not measured: @app.get() in the installed FastAPI 0.128.8 registers GET only (no HEAD literal in .venv/Lib/site-packages/fastapi/routing.py outside the head() decorator and its docs), so the HEAD request falls through the API route to the static mount, which 404s a path it does not have
head_finding.impact: none for the demo: the audio element and the browser use GET with Range, which answers 206

trial_measurements.command_line: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -B -c "from scripts.auditory_ui.demo import load_trial; ..." (timestamps[-1] - timestamps[0] per converted npz)
trial_measurements.note: scripts/auditory_ui/README.md now reads 'trial_008 is one of the short trials (~125 s); most S1 trials are 389-399 s (trial_004: 388.992 s, measured)'. Both halves match these measurements; the '124 s' wording the task brief quoted is no longer in the file.

verified_versus_assumed.verified_by_running: every status code above, the URL, the serve-window log line, the trial spans, the 206 Content-Range
verified_versus_assumed.read_from_code: the drive()/runner() phase structure, the --browser and --serve-seconds semantics, the frontend's inactive/stale handling
verified_versus_assumed.assumed: the mechanism behind the HEAD 404 (no framework instrumentation was run)
